summary: The root "njm" primarily refers to a star or constellation, especially the Pleiades. It can also describe sprouts emerging from roots, resembling large needles.
lane: نَجْمٌ ذ [ A star. -b2- Also, An asterism, or constellation: being applied autonomastically to] the Pleiades. (S.) -b3- نُجُومٌ [like عِرْقٌ ] signifies also The sprouts from the roots [of a tree, or shrub], before the رَبِيع [meaning either spring or autumn ], the heads of which one sees like large needles, clearing the ground. (TA.) See عُسْلُوجٌ . -b4- نَجْمٌ also signifies (tropical:) The time when a payment falls due. (Msb.) [Hence, app., an ex. cited voce طىٌّ .] -b5- And hence, (Msb,) (tropical:) An instalment: syn. وَظِيفَةٌ . (Mgh, Msb.) See also عَزْلٌ . -b6- نَجْمٌ and نَجْمَةٌ A kind of plant, triticum repens or dogs' grass: see ثِيلٌ .
